anchor_selection.algorithm: lab products from real_catalog_lab_products.json, then per category_key the first N products by md5(seed || ':' || parent_asin) ascending, ties by product_id, excluding lab products; every anchor has a stored embedding

provenance.truth_method: exact cosine top-k per anchor and filter with enable_indexscan and enable_bitmapscan set off inside SET/RESET pairs; ordered by distance then product_id so ties are deterministic; the anchor itself is included when it passes the filter; recall is id overlap divided by the exact rows that exist, so a filter matching fewer than k rows is scored against those rows
provenance.timing_method: server_ms is the p50 across all anchors of EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS) on a second warmed execution; client_ms is the wall clock of the first execution from the benchmark host and includes the network; one sequential connection; no cold-cache, concurrency or end-to-end application claim

index.name: mosaic_search.product_search_vector_idx
index.definition: CREATE INDEX product_search_vector_idx ON mosaic_search.product_listing USING hnsw (embedding vector_cosine_ops) WITH (m='16', ef_construction='200')

exact_baseline.truth_source: mosaic_bench.exact_neighbor rows seeded for this catalog, anchor set and preset predicates

missing_predicate.execution: second execution of the same statement on this connection; the first returned the rows, so buffers were already warm
missing_predicate.note: the served index is total, so the predicate is not required to reach it; this row records that the query without it still used the index

representations.note: Same current embeddings and exact fp32 ground truth. Existing indexes; build time not measured here.

blog_operating_point.correction: Deeper-search comparison on the same anchors.
blog_operating_point.tradeoff: These settings use different search effort. Compare recall with both time and index size.
